question: I attack a battlefield with one 5 Might unit. My opponent has two 3 Might units defending there. Can I assign 3 damage to one and 2 to the other, or must it be split differently?
notes: Well-supported ruling: lethal damage must be assigned in full before moving on (CR 467.2.c.3).

question: I played Elnuk Herd from face down. Can its play ability give +3 Might to Elnuk Herd itself?
notes: Printed text said 'another friendly unit'; the Radiance errata (2026-10-09) changed it to 'a friendly unit'. The answer must use the errata wording.

question: Can I score the same battlefield twice in one turn if I conquer it, leave, and conquer it again?
notes: CR 472: a player may only score once per battlefield per turn.

question: Is Called Shot allowed in my deck?
notes: Gameplay rules do not forbid it, but it is banned in sanctioned Constructed (Rules Hub legality list). The answer should separate the two.

question: When Standard rotation starts in 2028, which sets will rotate out?
notes: Riot only says it intends to start rotation in 2028 and publishes no 2028 list. TR 601.3.b (Standard = current year's sets plus the previous year's) implies every set legal today rotates out. Either answer from TR 601.3 or say the sources do not settle it; never invent a list without citing it.
